cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I spent my Saturday fixing your fence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Three panels, eighteen screws, two shops and one blister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll recommend you to next door. They've got six panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them three took my whole Saturday before you make me sound available for Sunday.

mechanism: A approves a recommendation only if it accurately acknowledges the time and inconvenience already contributed.
confusable: Seeking more work or general expertise credit would miss D33; A must insist that the actual labor cost is recognized.
comparison: Fence repair and an unwanted follow-on recommendation differ from the grocery scene welcome care and public rest explanation.
seedUse: Use D33-b panels, screws, shops and blister; S01 conditional approval governs the neighbor recommendation.
